reason: Both model methods chain only a success `.then` (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:40-60) and the controller actions discard the returned promise (app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:51-65), unlike `save`/`destroy` which call `bootbox.alert` on rejection (lines 84-87, 103-105). `Discourse.ajax` only rejects the promise and shows no global error UI (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/mixins/ajax.js:51-67), so a 422 from `add_members`/`remove_member` or a 500 fails silently.
